title: TCSExam: Evaluating Frontier LLMs on the Full Range of TCS Research
abstract: arXiv:2611.07962v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Can large language models (LLMs) advance theoretical computer science and resolve its long-standing open conjectures? To study progress toward this goal, we introduce TCSExam, a unified framework and benchmark covering the full range of TCS research. It evaluates theorem proving, solver engineering, and constructions alongside direct attempts to resolve open conjectures, capturing both concrete research accomplishments and progress toward long-standing research goals. TCSExam-Full contains 100 expert-reviewed tasks, with submissions checked by the Lean kernel or an executable task checker. TCSExam-Lite selects 20 tasks, five per track, reducing the number of task attempts by 80% at the same per-attempt budget. We evaluate eight agents on Full and nine on Lite. translated_title: TCSExam：评估前沿大语言模型在理论计算机科学研究全领域的能力
translated_abstract: 大语言模型（LLM）能否推动理论计算机科学（TCS）的发展，并解决其长期悬而未决的开放猜想？为了研究朝着这一目标的进展，我们提出了TCSExam，一个涵盖理论计算机科学研究全领域的统一框架和基准测试。它评估定理证明、求解器工程和构造性结果，以及对解决开放猜想的直接尝试，既捕捉具体的研究成果，也衡量朝向长期研究目标的进展。TCSExam-Full包含100个经专家审阅的任务，提交的答案由Lean内核或可执行的任务检查器进行验证。TCSExam-Lite从中选取20个任务（每个赛道5个），在相同的单次尝试预算下将任务尝试次数减少了80%。我们在Full上评估了八个智能体，在Lite上评估了九个。综合所有四个赛道的TCSExam指数显示：GPT-6 Astra在Full上领先（71.9分），Opus 5.5在Lite上领先（72.3分）。在八个共同评估的智能体上，Full和Lite的排名高度一致。
tldr: 该论文提出涵盖定理证明、求解器工程、构造和开放猜想求解四个赛道、共100个专家审阅任务的TCSExam基准，首次系统评估前沿大语言模型在理论计算机科学研究全领域的能力，结果显示GPT-6 Astra在完整版（71.9分）和Opus 5.5在精简版（72.3分）上分别领先。
en_tdlr: TCSExam is a unified expert-reviewed benchmark spanning the full range of TCS research—theorem proving, solver engineering, constructions, and direct attempts at open conjectures—with GPT-6 Astra leading the Full version (71.9) and Opus 5.5 leading the Lite version (72.3).
